title: SharedOutreachRecipientsResponse
description: Every email address the participating member tenants hold for the practitioner, private ones included, to pre-fill the shared outreach composer. For sending only: not a data record, and nothing is stored when it is read.

recipients.description: One entry per distinct address (case-insensitive); may be empty.

SharedOutreachRecipient.description: One address the composer may send to.

email.description: The address, trimmed, in the casing it was first found in.

tenantIds.description: The member tenants holding this address, in tenant order.

sources.description: Where it was found, each one of: primaryEmail, caqhPrimaryEmail, secondaryEmail, emails (the practitioner email fields on a member workflow), or caqhExtracted (the email read from the member's CAQH application form).
